text.font-family: Geist, 'Segoe UI', 'SF Pro Text', Roboto, sans-serif

svg.text: 3.2 Attention

text.font-family: Geist, 'Segoe UI', 'SF Pro Text', Roboto, sans-serif

svg.text: An attention function can be described as mapping a query and a set of key-value pairs to an

text.font-family: Geist, 'Segoe UI', 'SF Pro Text', Roboto, sans-serif

svg.text: output, where the query, keys, values, and output are all vectors. The output is computed as a

text.font-family: Geist, 'Segoe UI', 'SF Pro Text', Roboto, sans-serif

svg.text: weighted sum of the values, where the weight assigned to each value is computed by a

text.font-family: Geist, 'Segoe UI', 'SF Pro Text', Roboto, sans-serif

svg.text: compatibility function of the query with the corresponding key.

text.font-family: Geist, 'Segoe UI', 'SF Pro Text', Roboto, sans-serif

svg.text: 3.2.1 Scaled Dot-Product Attention

text.font-family: Geist, 'Segoe UI', 'SF Pro Text', Roboto, sans-serif

svg.text: We call our particular attention "Scaled Dot-Product Attention" (Figure 2). The input consists of

text.font-family: Geist, 'Segoe UI', 'SF Pro Text', Roboto, sans-serif

svg.text: queries and keys of dimension dk, and values of dimension dv. We compute the dot products of

text.font-family: Geist, 'Segoe UI', 'SF Pro Text', Roboto, sans-serif

svg.text: the query with all keys, divide each by √dk, and apply a softmax function to obtain the weights

text.font-family: Geist, 'Segoe UI', 'SF Pro Text', Roboto, sans-serif

svg.text: on the values.

text.font-family: Geist, 'Segoe UI', 'SF Pro Text', Roboto, sans-serif

svg.text: In practice, we compute the attention function on a set of queries simultaneously, packed

text.font-family: Geist, 'Segoe UI', 'SF Pro Text', Roboto, sans-serif

svg.text: together into a matrix Q. The keys and values are also packed together into matrices K and V. We

text.font-family: Geist, 'Segoe UI', 'SF Pro Text', Roboto, sans-serif

svg.text: compute the matrix of outputs as:

text.font-family: Geist, 'Segoe UI', 'SF Pro Text', Roboto, sans-serif

svg.text: Attention(Q, K, V) = softmax(QK^T / √dk) V (1)

text.font-family: Geist, 'Segoe UI', 'SF Pro Text', Roboto, sans-serif

svg.text: The two most commonly used attention functions are additive attention [2], and dot-product

text.font-family: Geist, 'Segoe UI', 'SF Pro Text', Roboto, sans-serif

svg.text: (multiplicative) attention. Dot-product attention is identical to our algorithm, except for the scaling

text.font-family: Geist, 'Segoe UI', 'SF Pro Text', Roboto, sans-serif

svg.text: factor of 1/√dk. Additive attention computes the compatibility function using a feed-forward

text.font-family: Geist, 'Segoe UI', 'SF Pro Text', Roboto, sans-serif

svg.text: network with a single hidden layer. While the two are similar in theoretical complexity,

text.font-family: Geist, 'Segoe UI', 'SF Pro Text', Roboto, sans-serif

svg.text: dot-product attention is much faster and more space-efficient in practice, since it can be

text.font-family: Geist, 'Segoe UI', 'SF Pro Text', Roboto, sans-serif

svg.text: implemented using highly optimized matrix multiplication code.

text.font-family: Geist, 'Segoe UI', 'SF Pro Text', Roboto, sans-serif

svg.text: While for small values of dk the two mechanisms perform similarly, additive attention

text.font-family: Geist, 'Segoe UI', 'SF Pro Text', Roboto, sans-serif

svg.text: outperforms dot product attention without scaling for larger values of dk [3]. We suspect that for

text.font-family: Geist, 'Segoe UI', 'SF Pro Text', Roboto, sans-serif

svg.text: large values of dk, the dot products grow large in magnitude, pushing the softmax function into

text.font-family: Geist, 'Segoe UI', 'SF Pro Text', Roboto, sans-serif

svg.text: regions where it has extremely small gradients. To counteract this effect, we scale the dot

text.font-family: Geist, 'Segoe UI', 'SF Pro Text', Roboto, sans-serif

svg.text: products by 1/√dk.

text.font-family: Geist, 'Segoe UI', 'SF Pro Text', Roboto, sans-serif

svg.text: 3.2.2 Multi-Head Attention

text.font-family: Geist, 'Segoe UI', 'SF Pro Text', Roboto, sans-serif

svg.text: Instead of performing a single attention function with dmodel-dimensional keys, values and

text.font-family: Geist, 'Segoe UI', 'SF Pro Text', Roboto, sans-serif

svg.text: queries, we found it beneficial to linearly project the queries, keys and values h times with

text.font-family: Geist, 'Segoe UI', 'SF Pro Text', Roboto, sans-serif

svg.text: different, learned linear projections to dk, dk and dv dimensions, respectively. On each of these

text.font-family: Geist, 'Segoe UI', 'SF Pro Text', Roboto, sans-serif

svg.text: projected versions of queries, keys and values we then perform the attention function in parallel,

text.font-family: Geist, 'Segoe UI', 'SF Pro Text', Roboto, sans-serif

svg.text: yielding dv-dimensional output values. These are concatenated and once again projected,

text.font-family: Geist, 'Segoe UI', 'SF Pro Text', Roboto, sans-serif

svg.text: resulting in the final values.

text.font-family: Geist, 'Segoe UI', 'SF Pro Text', Roboto, sans-serif

svg.text: Multi-head attention allows the model to jointly attend to information from different

text.font-family: Geist, 'Segoe UI', 'SF Pro Text', Roboto, sans-serif

svg.text: representation subspaces at different positions. With a single attention head, averaging inhibits

text.font-family: Geist, 'Segoe UI', 'SF Pro Text', Roboto, sans-serif

svg.text: this.

text.font-family: Geist, 'Segoe UI', 'SF Pro Text', Roboto, sans-serif

svg.text: MultiHead(Q, K, V) = Concat(head1, ..., headh) W^O (2)

text.font-family: Geist, 'Segoe UI', 'SF Pro Text', Roboto, sans-serif

svg.text: In this work we employ h = 8 parallel attention layers, or heads. For each of these we use dk = dv

text.font-family: Geist, 'Segoe UI', 'SF Pro Text', Roboto, sans-serif

svg.text: = dmodel/h = 64. Due to the reduced dimension of each head, the total computational cost is

text.font-family: Geist, 'Segoe UI', 'SF Pro Text', Roboto, sans-serif

svg.text: similar to that of single-head attention with full dimensionality.

text.font-family: Geist, 'Segoe UI', 'SF Pro Text', Roboto, sans-serif

svg.text: 3.3 Position-wise Feed-Forward Networks

text.font-family: Geist, 'Segoe UI', 'SF Pro Text', Roboto, sans-serif

svg.text: In addition to attention sub-layers, each of the layers in our encoder and decoder contains a fully

text.font-family: Geist, 'Segoe UI', 'SF Pro Text', Roboto, sans-serif

svg.text: connected feed-forward network, which is applied to each position separately and identically.

text.font-family: Geist, 'Segoe UI', 'SF Pro Text', Roboto, sans-serif

svg.text: This consists of two linear transformations with a ReLU activation in between.
